name: Yumemidori 1.5
source:
A year after the 'example event'.
Makoto Mizusawa was on summer holiday when his classmate Kasahara invited him to go camping.

This is a very peaceful summer story.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/12673]Freem![/url]]

[spoiler]Set after the secret route's GOOD END of [url=https://vndb.org/v24363]Yumemidori[/url].[/spoiler]
translation:
“示例事件”一年后。
水泽诚正在放暑假，他的同学笠原邀请他去露营。

这是一个非常平静的夏日故事。
